title: Delivery can’t find me suddenly
text: We were enjoying these boxes. Yes they are expensive but for my cat who loved them I splurged and was happy. Then the third box was listed as undeliverable even though the address is exactly the same. It’s a single dwelling house- nothing complicated or unusual. I waited for a refund and finally put in a direct request because it wasn’t happening on its own. So Amazon said it has been done and I’ll check my credit card tomorrow. But i unfortunately decided to cancel future shipments as I don’t feel like having to go through this again. Sad because the toys were cute.
label: neutral
